description: go.mod with two malformed require lines. The valid require is still listed; the bad lines must surface as scan incompleteness, and nothing may be called unused for this project because the declared set is not fully known.
verdictNote: Go never reports unused in M2 (arch lead ruling, 2026-09-24): tools.go and blank imports, build tags and the edgeless module graph cannot tell not-imported from not-seen. The Go adapter does not declare referenceAnalysis, so no dependency here may get an unused verdict.
